name: Miyakura Fuuko
source:
The protagonist, Taichi's mother.

Until recently, she worked as an office lady, but quit her job when Taichi became a high school exam candidate to become a housewife.

However, due to her airheaded personality and having never properly done housework before, she can't manage a single task well.

She trips and shows her underwear, her skirt blows up in the wind, someone always walks in while she's changing...

She possesses a natural talent—or rather, a destiny—for distracting men. But she herself is blissfully oblivious, unaware that this is a major problem.

[From [url=http://www.r18game.com/tougenkyo/lucky/chara.html]official site[/url]]
